Loss report: concourse -> tekton
[emulated] pipeline/ci/job/build/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/0 trigger.schedule: CronJob posting to the EventListener (CronJob ci-schedule-0 posts to el-pipemaster-schedule in namespace default; deploy both in that namespace, or edit the host. The post has an empty body, so every ctx-* param is empty and a clone step has no repository. The entry matches only the X-Pipemaster-Schedule header, so any pod that reaches the service of listener pipemaster-schedule can start a run. The listener has no Ingress, and the webhook listener pipemaster does not take schedule entries. Do not expose pipemaster-schedule, and limit it with a NetworkPolicy that admits only the CronJob pods)
[emulated] pipeline/ci/trigger/1 trigger.schedule: CronJob posting to the EventListener (CronJob ci-schedule-1 posts to el-pipemaster-schedule in namespace default; deploy both in that namespace, or edit the host. The post has an empty body, so every ctx-* param is empty and a clone step has no repository. The entry matches only the X-Pipemaster-Schedule header, so any pod that reaches the service of listener pipemaster-schedule can start a run. The listener has no Ingress, and the webhook listener pipemaster does not take schedule entries. Do not expose pipemaster-schedule, and limit it with a NetworkPolicy that admits only the CronJob pods)
